items.t: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) Keeps Bearish View On US Treasuries
items.sum: T. Rowe Price Group (NasdaqGS:TROW) keeps a bearish stance on US Treasuries while increasing exposure to UK government bonds. The allocation shift reflects the view that UK gilts currently offer a more attractive risk and return trade off than US debt. Fund managers are adjusting fixed income holdings in response to inflation pressures, geopolitical risks, and changing central bank policy paths. T

items.t: A 72-Year-Old With $350,000 in AT&T, ONEOK and T. Rowe Price Collects $1,457 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $350,000 portfolio split evenly across AT&T, ONEOK and T. Rowe Price pays about $17,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices.

items.t: T. ROWE PRICE EXPANDS CAPITAL APPRECIATION SUITE WITH NEW FIXED INCOME EXCHANGE TRADED FUND
items.sum: T. Rowe Price, a global investment management firm and a leader in retirement, announced today the addition of the T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Fixed Income ETF [Ticker: TFIX]. It began trading on the NYSE Arca today, and marks the fourth exchange-traded fund (ETF) to the Capital Appreciation suite of funds, and the only focused solely on fixed income.

items.t: T. ROWE PRICE BUILDS ON COLLABORATIVE INVESTMENT APPROACH WITH EXPANDED PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT TEAMS
items.sum: T. Rowe Price (NASDAQ: TROW) today announced that it is expanding its use of portfolio manager teams across twelve investment strategies, building on its long-standing fundamental research capabilities and collaborative approach to investment management. Each strategy's investment philosophy, process, and risk parameters remain unchanged.
